compute_policy: local CPU/local GTX 1050 only; no HF cpu-upgrade, Jobs, paid, or remote compute
selection_rationale: Anchored six-claim contract; pinned arXiv source directly supplies the closed-form Stein identity estimator and deterministic local CPU formula fixtures. Image-generation FID claims are deferred as non-CPU-feasible full benchmarks.

claim_1_outcome.scope: Deterministic one-dimensional Gaussian forward-coupling evaluation of the exact source reference-free gamma formula versus direct MSE-optimal gamma. It preserves the formula and coefficient metric but is not end-to-end SteinDiff sampling or theorem validation.

claim_2_outcome.scope: Finite local CPU one-dimensional paired-particle execution of the source thm:mse_decay algebra: exact-coefficient one-step MSE identity, trajectory product, and eta bound for a synthetic noisy affine candidate. It is not learned SteinDiff inference or theorem verification.
